title: fagelia cana
intro: Fagelia cana, commonly known as the 'Woolly Fagelia', is a plant species that belongs to the family Myoporaceae. This plant is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve respiratory health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fagelia cana include its use as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant, making it a potential treatment for various conditions such as bronchitis, coughs, and skin infections. The bioactive constituents of Fagelia cana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
